assumptions.cost_convention: Roundtrip costs/slippage deducted from exit proceeds, floored at zero; maximum loss is the all-in position budget.
assumptions.drawdown: Realized SOL equity aggregated by exit timestamp; no mark-to-market or executable intratrade drawdown.
assumptions.exit_availability: Guaranteed only by the synthetic generator; complete labels required, never a market-data claim.
assumptions.same_timestamp_order: Aggregate all exits before deterministic mint-ordered entries; a synthetic convention, not a network guarantee.

uncertainty.limitation: Conditions on executed cohorts; not a confidence interval for market profitability, drawdown or ruin.

fx_assumption: No USD data: every generated return and capital amount is denominated in SOL.
selection_rule: Highest validation net SOL PnL at 1000bps cost + 300bps slippage; fixed policy-order tie break; minimum 5 executions in train and validation.
